eval.notes: Output-quality axis is N/A: qualityContext is empty, so there are no C-rules and no output-axis totals; numeric metrics are in metrics/metricValues. Context axis is non-discriminating for this task: the declared concept context set (ACTION-CONCEPT-HOT-* code gates + FACT-REPO-* repo facts) has no application surface in a product-concept document about login redirects, so every context cell scores 0 (not demonstrable) for ctx-on and ctx-off alike. The shared manifest input routines/skill-eval/briefs/concept/login_intent.md was absent from the worktree and reachable roots; brief content was inferred from verbatim references in the run outputs, so contradiction-audit and assumptions-novelty probes could not be run mechanically.

rubric.rule: Ask the user for the feature name and a description if not already provided.
Derive a directory slug (lowercase, underscores, e.g. login_intent).
Create plans/{slug}/concept/concept.md using the Overview Template.
Create plans/{slug}/concept/user_stories.md using the User Stories Template.
If the user provides enough specifics for an implementation block, create the Detailed Design page.
Set status to Draft.
Read existing concept docs at the path the user indicates (or find them in plans/).
Apply user feedback: expand sections, add detail, add new design pages, resolve open questions.
Do NOT remove content the user did not ask to change.
Preserve existing section structure unless restructuring is requested.
With a non-empty Open Questions section, offer to continue into /clarify in the same session.
Skip the offer when Open Questions is empty or the user has scoped the session to drafting only.
Write concise, direct prose. No filler or hedging.
Use tables for structured data (thresholds, field definitions, limits).
Use numbered steps for sequential flows. Indent sub-steps for backend/system logic.
Use concrete examples to clarify non-obvious rules or edge cases.
Reference existing project services by name when relevant (consult service-map.md).
Number open questions for easy reference in discussions.
Every MVP and Backlog item carries a day estimate; each block states its total.
Group stories by theme; HR dividers between groups; independent, testable, small, specific.
Present an approved example implementation in the plan before writing SQL with CTEs.
Present an approved example implementation in the plan before writing concurrency primitives.
Present an approved example implementation in the plan before introducing a new interface or generic type.
Write the source the generator consumes; never freehand generated output.
Present an approved example before adding, weakening, or removing validation/transaction/guard logic.
Present an approved example in the plan before using an anonymous (inline) struct type.
Deployment is script-driven: sync_skills.sh / sync_context.sh / sync_settings.sh / sync_hooks.sh.
The config server is the UI over skills/context/proposals/routines; it shells out to the sync scripts.
Sessions run in pool worktrees under .claude/worktrees/<name> on claude/* branches; commits invisible until merged.
Go 1.26 module github.com/kevinhorst/smine; make audit is the only quality gate.

probes.name: context-injection
probes.result: context_record.sh: all four ctx-on runs received the identical 10-entry set [ACTION-CONCEPT-HOT-001..006, FACT-REPO-ARCH-001..003, FACT-REPO-STACK-001]; all four ctx-off runs received zero injected entries.

probes.name: context-applicability
probes.result: The injected concept-context set is code-writing doctrine (HOT gates) plus claude-configs repo-mechanics facts, none of which have an application surface in a login-redirect product concept. The context axis is non-discriminating here: 0/10 across all runs, ctx-on and ctx-off alike.

probes.name: tables-vs-bullets
probes.result: 1/8 runs (default.ctx-on.r2) rendered a validation-rules markdown table; the other 7 used bullet lists for Limits/Models/validation. Payload template SKILL-CONCEPT-TPL-002 prescribes bullet layout for Limits/Models, in tension with review guideline WRITING-002.

probes.name: block-totals
probes.result: Per-item day estimates present in all 8 runs; explicit per-block totals present in 4 (default.ctx-on.r2, default.ctx-off.r1, default.ctx-off.r2, no-closing.ctx-off.r2), absent in the other 4.

probes.name: closing-gate
probes.result: All 4 default runs explicitly and correctly skipped the /clarify offer citing the unattended/drafting-only scope (CLOSING-002 satisfied); none could extend an interactive offer in a headless run (CLOSING-001 not demonstrable). The no-closing variant has both rows stripped.

probes.name: self-report-vs-artifact
probes.result: The default.ctx-off.r2 closing summary claims a validation rules and limits table, but its emitted artifact contains no table (bullet lists only). Scored on the artifact.

probes.name: missing-shared-input
probes.result: Manifest input routines/skill-eval/briefs/concept/login_intent.md was absent from the worktree and reachable roots; the brief could not be read directly. Contradiction-audit and assumptions-novelty ratio probes could not be run mechanically.
